papers.title: Early clinical outcomes of the PERIQxA multicentre randomised double-blind trial evaluating postoperative antibiotics after perianal abscess drainage
papers.authors: Polaino-Moreno V, Ruiz-Antorán B, Caballero-Bermejo A, Artés-Caselles M, Kraft M, Serrano-González J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anal fistula frequently develops following surgical drainage of a first cryptoglandular perianal abscess. The role of postoperative antibiotics in preventing fistula formation remains uncertain.
METHODS: PERIQxA is a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating postoperative amoxicillin-clavulanate compared with placebo after surgical drainage of a first cryptoglandular perianal abscess. This report presents early clinical outcomes from the ongoing trial. Adults without systemic infection or immunosuppression were randomised 1:1 to receive oral amoxicillin-clavulanate (875/125 mg) or placebo every 8 h for 7 days. The primary outcome was anal fistula formation at 6 months.
RESULTS: Between March 2022 and May 2025, 65 participants were randomised. One participant withdrew consent and was excluded from all analyses. Fifty-seven participants (28 antibiotic, 29 placebo) were included in the primary analysis. At 6 months, anal fistula developed in 21.4% of participants allocated to amoxicillin-clavulanate and 31.0% allocated to placebo (odds ratio [OR] 0.61, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.18-2.01). At 12 months, fistula formation occurred in 28.6% and 41.4% of participants, respectively (OR 0.57, 95% CI 0.19-1.71). Lower rates of anal fistula formation were consistently observed in the antibiotic group at both time points, although these differences did not reach statistical significance. Obesity (body mass index > 30 kg/m2) was associated with fistula formation. No antibiotic-related safety concerns were identified.
CONCLUSIONS: In this early analysis of the ongoing PERIQxA trial, lower rates of anal fistula formation were observed among participants allocated to postoperative amoxicillin-clavulanate compared with placebo at both 6 and 12 months of follow-up, although these differences did not reach statistical significance. Given the limited sample size, these findings should be interpreted with caution and require confirmation. Additional evidence from PERIQxA, together with other ongoing randomised studies, will help clarify the role of postoperative antibiotic therapy in preventing anal fistula formation after perianal abscess drainage.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: EU Clinical Trials Information System, 2024-520193-35-00.

papers.title_zh: 評估肛周膿瘍引流術後抗生素之 PERIQxA 多中心隨機雙盲試驗：早期臨床結果
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：首次隱窩腺體源性肛周膿瘍接受手術引流後，經常會形成肛門廔管。術後抗生素在預防廔管形成方面的角色仍不確定。
方法：PERIQxA 是一項多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗，比較首次隱窩腺體源性肛周膿瘍手術引流後，使用 amoxicillin-clavulanate 與安慰劑的效果。本報告呈現這項進行中試驗的早期臨床結果。無全身性感染或免疫抑制的成人，以 1:1 隨機分派接受口服 amoxicillin-clavulanate（875/125 mg）或安慰劑，每 8 小時一次，持續 7 天。主要結果為 6 個月時的肛門廔管形成。
結果：2022 年 3 月至 2025 年 5 月間，共 65 名參與者接受隨機分派。1 名參與者撤回同意，並自所有分析中排除。主要分析納入 57 名參與者（抗生素組 28 人、安慰劑組 29 人）。6 個月時，分派至 amoxicillin-clavulanate 組的參與者有 21.4% 形成肛門廔管，安慰劑組則為 31.0%（勝算比［OR］0.61，95% 信賴區間［CI］0.18–2.01）。12 個月時，兩組廔管形成率分別為 28.6% 與 41.4%（OR 0.57，95% CI 0.19–1.71）。兩個時間點均一致觀察到抗生素組的肛門廔管形成率較低，但差異皆未達統計顯著。肥胖（身體質量指數 >30 kg/m²）與廔管形成有關。未發現抗生素相關的安全性疑慮。
結論：在這項仍持續進行中的 PERIQxA 試驗早期分析中，術後分派接受 amoxicillin-clavulanate 的參與者，在追蹤 6 個月及 12 個月時觀察到的肛門廔管形成率均低於安慰劑組，但差異皆未達統計顯著。由於樣本數有限，這些結果應審慎解讀，且仍需確認。PERIQxA 後續提供的證據，加上其他進行中的隨機試驗，將有助於釐清術後抗生素治療在預防肛周膿瘍引流後肛門廔管形成方面的角色。
試驗註冊：歐盟臨床試驗資訊系統，2024-520193-35-00。

papers.title: Efficacy of erector spinae plane block for patients with inflammatory bowel disease undergoing major abdominal surgery: A double-blind randomized controlled trial
papers.authors: Alhamdah Y, Gleicher Y, Dos Santos Fernandes H, Peacock S, Ye X, Brown C
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) undergoing abdominal surgery face challenges in postoperative recovery due to high opioid needs and limited analgesic alternatives. The erector spinae plane (ESP) block has been shown to improve recovery in abdominal procedures, but its efficacy in the IBD population remains unknown. We investigated whether bilateral ESP blocks improve postoperative quality of recovery in this population.
METHODS: In this prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial, adults with IBD scheduled for elective laparoscopic-assisted abdominal surgery were randomized to receive bilateral ESP blocks with either 0.5% ropivacaine or normal saline before induction of anesthesia. The primary outcome was quality of recovery assessed using the 15-item QoR (QoR-15) scale at postoperative day (POD) 2. Secondary outcomes included QoR-15 at POD 1 and 3, pain scores (VAS), opioid consumption, opioid-related side effects, and hospital length of stay.
RESULTS: Fifty-seven patients were randomized and analyzed: 31 in the ropivacaine group and 26 in the saline group. Baseline characteristics were generally similar between groups. The postoperative QoR-15, defined as the average QoR-15 scores over POD 1-3, was 10.2 points higher in the intervention group although not statistically significant (p = 0.27). The intervention group had a smaller decline in postoperative QoR-15 scores compared to controls (mean difference in the change of postoperative QoR-15 from baseline = 19.9 points; 95% CI: 2.3 to 37.5; p = 0.02). Baseline-adjusted longitudinal analysis also suggested higher QoR-15 scores on POD 2 in the intervention group (28.9-point difference; 95% CI: 3.9 to 53.8; p = 0.02). However, these adjusted findings should be interpreted cautiously because the confidence intervals were wide, indicating limited precision. Pain scores and opioid consumption were similar between groups. Constipation was less frequent in the intervention group on POD 2 (p = 0.041). No significant differences were found in hospital length of stay.
CONCLUSION: The unadjusted primary comparison of postoperative QoR-15 at POD2 was not statistically significant; however, the intervention group scored numerically higher by 23 points, a substantial difference in magnitude that was consistent with the statistically significant effects observed in both change score and longitudinal mixed-effects analyses. Bilateral ESP blocks did not significantly reduce postoperative pain or opioid use. Taken together, these findings suggest a possible, clinically meaningful recovery benefit that should be considered exploratory and requires confirmation in larger multicenter trials with early postoperative analgesic assessment and block-success verification.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT06230003.

papers.title_zh: 豎脊肌平面阻滯對接受重大腹部手術之發炎性腸道疾病病人的療效：雙盲隨機對照試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：接受腹部手術的發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）病人，因鴉片類藥物需求量高且其他止痛選擇有限，術後恢復面臨挑戰。豎脊肌平面（ESP）阻滯已被證實可改善腹部手術後的恢復，但其對IBD族群的療效仍不明。我們探討雙側ESP阻滯是否能改善此族群的術後恢復品質。
方法：這項前瞻性、雙盲、安慰劑對照隨機試驗，將預定接受選擇性腹腔鏡輔助腹部手術的成年IBD病人，隨機分配於麻醉誘導前接受以0.5%羅哌卡因或生理食鹽水施行的雙側ESP阻滯。主要結果為術後第2天（POD2）以15項恢復品質量表（QoR-15）評估的恢復品質。次要結果包括POD1與POD3的QoR-15、疼痛分數（VAS）、鴉片類藥物使用量、鴉片類藥物相關副作用及住院天數。
結果：共57名病人接受隨機分派並納入分析，其中羅哌卡因組31人，生理食鹽水組26人。兩組基線特徵大致相似。術後QoR-15定義為POD1至POD3的QoR-15平均分數；介入組高出10.2分，但未達統計顯著（p＝0.27）。與對照組相比，介入組術後QoR-15分數下降幅度較小（術後QoR-15相較基線之變化量的平均組間差＝19.9分；95%信賴區間：2.3至37.5；p＝0.02）。經基線校正的縱向分析亦顯示，介入組POD2的QoR-15分數較高（相差28.9分；95%信賴區間：3.9至53.8；p＝0.02）。然而，這些校正後的結果應審慎解讀，因其信賴區間寬廣，顯示估計精確度有限。兩組疼痛分數與鴉片類藥物使用量相近。介入組在POD2較少發生便祕（p＝0.041）。住院天數未見顯著差異。
結論：POD2術後QoR-15未經校正的主要比較未達統計顯著；然而，介入組分數在數值上高出23分，差異幅度可觀，且與變化量分析及縱向混合效應分析所觀察到的統計顯著效果一致。雙側ESP阻滯未顯著降低術後疼痛或鴉片類藥物使用量。整體而言，這些結果提示可能存在具臨床意義的恢復效益，但應視為探索性發現，並須由更大型、多中心試驗確認，且應納入術後早期止痛評估與阻滯成功與否的驗證。
試驗註冊：ClinicalTrials.gov識別碼NCT06230003。

papers.title: Efficacy of novel compression gloves and stockings for prevention oxaliplatin induced peripheral neuropathy, the randomized controlled trial
papers.journal_full: Journal of the Egyptian National Cancer Institute
papers.authors: Leksuwankun S, Teeyapun N, Parinyanitikul N, Luangdilok S, Amornvit J, Teeramongkonrasmee A
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Given that oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy (OIPN) is a common and dose-limiting toxicity in colorectal cancer and that effective preventive strategies remain limited, this study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of compression therapy for the prevention of OIPN.
METHODS: We conducted a randomized controlled trial in patients with stage III colorectal cancer receiving oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy, comparing pressure-controlled compression gloves and stockings during oxaliplatin infusion with usual care. The primary outcome was the incidence of grade ≥ 2 oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy (OIPN) assessed using NCI-CTCAE. Secondary outcomes included patient-reported neuropathy (EORTC QLQ-CIPN20), neuropathic pain (DN4), autonomic symptoms (Thai COMPASS-31), pain intensity (Wong-Baker Faces Pain Scale), and quantitative sensory testing. Longitudinal outcomes were analysed using mixed-effects models.
RESULTS: Twenty-five patients (17 compression, 8 control) were included in the final analysis. The incidence of grade ≥ 2 OIPN did not differ significantly between groups (17.6% vs. 25.0%, p = 1.00). However, the compression group demonstrated a significantly smaller increase in total CIPN20 scores compared with controls (median change 3.51 vs. 7.96; p = 0.04). Significant intervention-by-time interactions were observed for overall, sensory, and motor CIPN20 scores, as well as DN4 scores, indicating slower symptom progression with compression therapy. No significant differences were observed in autonomic symptoms, quantitative sensory testing, or pain intensity. There were no device-related adverse events.
CONCLUSION: Compression therapy did not significantly reduce clinician-graded OIPN but was associated with a trend toward slower progression of patient-reported neuropathy and neuropathic pain, supporting further evaluation in larger trials. (Thai Clinical Trials Registry: TCTR20221107006; registered 7 November 2022).

papers.title_zh: 新型加壓手套與加壓襪預防奧沙利鉑誘發周邊神經病變的療效：隨機對照試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：奧沙利鉑誘發周邊神經病變（OIPN）是大腸直腸癌治療中常見且會限制劑量的毒性，而有效的預防策略仍有限，因此本研究旨在評估加壓治療預防 OIPN 的療效。
方法：本研究為隨機對照試驗，納入接受含奧沙利鉑化學治療的第三期大腸直腸癌患者，比較在奧沙利鉑輸注期間使用壓力控制式加壓手套與加壓襪，以及一般照護。主要結果為使用 NCI-CTCAE 評估的第 ≥2 級 OIPN 發生率。次要結果包括病人自述神經病變（EORTC QLQ-CIPN20）、神經病理性疼痛（DN4）、自主神經症狀（泰文版 COMPASS-31）、疼痛強度（Wong-Baker 臉譜疼痛量表），以及定量感覺測試。縱向結果使用混合效應模型分析。
結果：最終分析納入25名患者（加壓組17名、對照組8名）。兩組第 ≥2 級 OIPN 發生率無統計顯著差異（17.6% vs. 25.0%，p＝1.00）。然而，加壓組 CIPN20 總分的增加幅度顯著小於對照組（變化量中位數3.51 vs. 7.96；p＝0.04）。CIPN20 整體、感覺及運動分數，以及 DN4 分數，均觀察到顯著的介入與時間交互作用，顯示加壓治療下症狀進展較慢。自主神經症狀、定量感覺測試及疼痛強度均無顯著差異。未發生裝置相關不良事件。
結論：加壓治療未顯著降低臨床醫師分級的 OIPN，但與病人自述神經病變及神經病理性疼痛進展較慢的趨勢相關，支持以更大型試驗進一步評估。（泰國臨床試驗登錄：TCTR20221107006；登錄日期為2022年11月7日。）

papers.title: Impact of a multicomponent health literacy intervention for general practitioners and patients on colorectal cancer screening in underserved areas in France-the DECODE pragmatic, cluster randomised controlled trial
papers.ptype: Randomized Controlled Trial, Pragmatic Clinical Trial
papers.authors: Redmond N, Lamouroux A, Fenni R, Addamiano M, Kaou M, Doukhi Z
papers.abstract: European colorectal cancer (CCR) screening programmes reduce mortality, yet participation in France remains low, particularly among individuals with limited health literacy (HL) and lower socioeconomic position. The DECODE trial assessed whether a combined HL intervention for General Practitioners (GPs) and eligible patients could improve CRC screening uptake after 1 year in French underserved areas. A two-arm cluster-randomised controlled trial in GP practices in underserved areas across four French regions was conducted. Practices were block-randomised (1:1) to intervention or usual care. The intervention combined HL-focussed interactive GP training with a patient-oriented pictorial brochure and video explaining the 'at-home' faecal immunochemical test (FIT). Patients aged 50-74 years, eligible for screening were recruited during routine consultations. Intervention GPs used their HL training to explain the FIT, and provided it alongside the patient-oriented materials; control arm GPs provided the FIT in their usual way. The primary outcome was FIT uptake at 1 year. Secondary outcomes, together with sociodemographic data, precarity, and HL levels, were examined. Mixed-effects logistic regression was performed accounting for clustering and baseline differences. Fifty-seven GPs (27 practices) were randomised and 1065 patients recruited (494 intervention, 571 control); 1022 were analysed. CRC screening uptake in the intervention arm (70.8%, 335/473) was increased compared to the control (64.5%, 354/549) (OR: 2.28, CI: 1.01-5.53, P = .046). No differences were observed for secondary outcomes. A multicomponent HL intervention targeting GP-patient interactions in underserved populations can improve CRC screening uptake within 1 year and may reduce related inequities, with future policy implications. Clinical trials registration: ClinicalTrials.gov, Trial registration number: 2020-A01687-32, Date of registration: 17th November 2020. URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT04631692. Protocol version: Manuscript based on study protocol version 1.3, 07 January 2022.

papers.abstract_zh: 歐洲大腸直腸癌（CCR）篩檢計畫可降低死亡率，但法國的參與率仍偏低，健康識能（HL）有限及社經地位較低者尤其如此。DECODE試驗評估：在法國醫療資源不足地區，同時針對全科醫師（GP）及符合篩檢資格病人進行健康識能介入，能否提高1年後的大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢參與率。本研究在法國四個地區之醫療資源不足地區的全科診所，進行雙組叢集隨機對照試驗。診所以區塊隨機分派方式，按1：1分至介入組或常規照護組。介入結合以健康識能為重點的全科醫師互動式訓練，以及向病人解說「居家」糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）的圖像手冊與影片。在例行門診中招募50至74歲、符合篩檢資格的病人。介入組全科醫師運用健康識能訓練解說FIT，並同時提供FIT及病人導向的教材；對照組全科醫師則依平常方式提供FIT。主要結果為1年時的FIT參與率。研究亦檢視次要結果，以及社會人口學資料、社會經濟脆弱處境與健康識能程度。分析採用混合效應邏輯斯迴歸，納入叢集效應及基線差異。共57名全科醫師（27間診所）接受隨機分派，招募1065名病人（介入組494人、對照組571人）；1022人納入分析。介入組CRC篩檢參與率為70.8%（335/473），高於對照組的64.5%（354/549）（OR：2.28，信賴區間：1.01–5.53，P＝.046）。次要結果未觀察到差異。針對醫療資源不足族群中醫病互動的多組成健康識能介入，可提高1年內的CRC篩檢參與率，並可能減少相關不平等，對未來政策具有意涵。臨床試驗註冊：ClinicalTrials.gov，試驗註冊編號：2020-A01687-32，註冊日期：2020年11月17日。網址：https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT04631692。試驗計畫書版本：本文依據2022年1月7日的試驗計畫書第1.3版撰寫。

papers.title: Reimagining inflammatory bowel disease in the age of artificial intelligence: discovery, care, education, and sustainability for the next decade
papers.authors: Iacucci M, Zammarchi I, Pugliano C, Hanauer S, Peyrin-Biroulet L
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving from task-specific algorithms to multimodal foundation models capable of integrating heterogeneous biological and clinical data across the health-care continuum. In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this transformation offers an unprecedented opportunity to move beyond fragmented analyses toward a unified understanding and management of disease. Artificial intelligence is emerging as the connective infrastructure linking scientific discovery, therapeutic development, patient care, education, and health-care delivery systems into continuously learning ecosystems. In this viewpoint, we explore how AI may reshape IBD over the next decade through 5 interconnected domains. Advances in multimodal AI accelerate biological discovery by integrating multiomics, spatial biology, and foundation models to identify mechanistic disease endotypes. Simultaneously, AI can shorten the path from molecular discovery to therapeutic innovation by supporting target identification, predicting protein structure, drug positioning, and adaptive clinical trial design. These scientific advances converge at the bedside, where multimodal AI may transform patient care from reactive management to predictive precision medicine through integrated diagnostics, digital biomarkers, real-time monitoring and individualized risk prediction. Beyond clinical care, AI is redefining medical education by enabling adaptive learning, explainable decision support, and democratized specialist expertise, while contributing to sustainable health care through optimized resource allocation, workforce support, and continuously learning systems. Realizing this vision will require robust governance, interoperability, prospective validation, and equitable implementation. If responsibly deployed, AI holds the potential to redefine IBD diagnosis, classification, therapeutic strategies and management within an intelligent ecosystem able to accelerate discovery, personalize care, and improve outcomes for patients and health-care systems alike.

papers.title_zh: 人工智慧時代重新構想發炎性腸道疾病：未來十年的探索、照護、教育與永續性
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智慧（AI）正迅速從任務專屬演算法，演進為能夠整合整個醫療照護連續體中異質性生物與臨床資料的多模態基礎模型。在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）領域，這項轉型提供了前所未有的機會，使我們得以超越片段式分析，邁向對疾病的整合理解與管理。人工智慧正逐漸成為連結科學探索、治療開發、病人照護、教育及醫療服務體系的基礎架構，將其串聯為持續學習的生態系統。在這篇觀點文章中，我們透過5個相互連結的領域，探討AI在未來十年可能如何重塑IBD。多模態AI的進展，透過整合多體學、空間生物學與基礎模型，以辨識具有機轉意義的疾病內型，進而加速生物學探索。同時，AI可藉由支援標的辨識、蛋白質結構預測、藥物定位及適應性臨床試驗設計，縮短從分子探索到治療創新的路徑。這些科學進展在臨床端匯聚，多模態AI可能透過整合式診斷、數位生物標記、即時監測及個別化風險預測，將病人照護從被動因應式管理轉變為預測性精準醫療。除了臨床照護之外，AI也正透過適應性學習、可解釋的決策支援，以及讓專科知識更普及，重新定義醫學教育；同時，藉由最佳化資源配置、支援醫療人力與持續學習系統，促進永續醫療。實現這項願景，需要健全的治理、互通性、前瞻性驗證及公平的實施。若能負責任地部署，AI有潛力在智慧生態系統中重新定義IBD的診斷、分類、治療策略與管理，讓此生態系統能夠加速探索、提供個人化照護，並改善病人與醫療體系的成果。

papers.title: Melatonin as a multi-target modulator of chemoresistance in colorectal cancer: mechanistic insights and clinical perspectives
papers.authors: Vaghari-Tabari M, Mahrooz A, Yousefi B, Molavand M
papers.abstract: Chemoresistance in colorectal cancer (CRC) occurs for several major reasons, such as the enhancement of chemotherapy drug efflux and the attenuation of apoptosis. Enhanced efflux of chemotherapy drugs occurs due to increased expression and activity of ABC family transporters, especially ABCB1 (P-gp). The attenuation of apoptosis in colorectal cancer cells occurs for various reasons, such as enhanced antioxidant defense, enhanced DNA damage repair, and changes in the expression of apoptosis-related proteins. The enhancement of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition and stemness and the dysregulation of cellular signaling pathways, such as PI3K/AKT, NF-κB, STAT3, and Wnt/β-catenin pathways, are also other important reasons for CRC chemoresistance. Interestingly, melatonin appears to attenuate chemoresistance in CRC cells. Numerous studies have demonstrated that melatonin influences nearly all key processes involved in CRC chemoresistance. Moreover, evidence from clinical studies suggesting the beneficial effects of melatonin in CRC chemotherapy is also available. In this article, we review the most interesting findings of all of these studies.

papers.title: Role of Bile Acids in Colorectal Diseases
papers.authors: Thirumal P, Azam M, Senthamizhselvan K
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Bile acids (BAs) have functions well beyond fat digestion. They also serve as signals linking the gut microbiota to gut health. This review examines how BAs affect colorectal diseases and how this knowledge can guide diagnosis and treatment.
RECENT FINDINGS: BAs and gut bacteria shape each other, and this balance affects the gut lining, immune system, and inflammation. Problems in BA handling are linked to bile acid diarrhea, post-cholecystectomy diarrhea, microscopic colitis, irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, and colorectal cancer. Ultra-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry and organoid models enable faster, more detailed BA testing. New treatments include BA binders, farnesoid X receptor-targeting drugs, and engineered gut bacteria. BAs play a central role in many colorectal diseases through their effects on gut bacteria and the gut lining. Better BA testing can improve diagnosis, and new BA- and microbiota-based treatments show promise. More studies are needed to bring these approaches into clinical practice.

papers.title: Impact of statins and aspirin on tumour response to total neoadjuvant therapy in advanced rectal cancer: A multicentre retrospective cohort study
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Bedrikovetski S, Lo J, Murshed I, Fitzsimmons T, Nguyen T, Price T
papers.abstract:
AIM: The role of statins and aspirin in modulating tumour response to total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) in advanced rectal cancer remains unclear. This study evaluates the impact of these medications on overall complete response (oCR) to TNT in patients with advanced rectal cancer.
METHODS: This multicentre, retrospective cohort study included patients with advanced rectal cancer treated with TNT with curative intent at five South Australian hospitals between 2019 and 2026. Medication use (statins and aspirin) was extracted from electronic medical records prior to TNT initiation. The primary outcome was the oCR rate, encompassing clinical complete response (cCR) and pathological complete response (pCR). Secondary outcomes included overall survival (OS), cancer-specific survival (CSS), disease-free survival (DFS) and local recurrence-free survival (LRFS).
RESULTS: Of 360 patients receiving TNT, 95 (26.4%) used statins and 30 (8.3%) used aspirin. No significant differences in oCR rates were observed between statin or aspirin users and non-users (51.9% vs. 40.8%, p = 0.068; 43.3% vs. 43.6%, p = 0.974, respectively). Similarly, no significant differences in cCR or pCR rates were observed for either statin or aspirin use. On logistic regression, achievement of oCR was not significantly associated with statin use (OR, 1.55; 95% CI, 0.97-2.48) or aspirin use (OR, 0.99; 95% CI, 0.47-2.10). Cox regression revealed no significant associations between statin or aspirin use and OS, CSS, DFS or LRFS.
CONCLUSION: Neither statin nor aspirin use was independently associated with improved tumour response to TNT in advanced rectal cancer.

papers.abstract_zh:
目的：他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈在調節進展期直腸癌對全程新輔助治療（TNT）之腫瘤反應方面的角色仍不清楚。本研究評估這些藥物對進展期直腸癌病人接受TNT後整體完全緩解（oCR）的影響。
方法：這項多中心回溯性世代研究納入2019年至2026年間，於南澳洲五家醫院接受根治意圖TNT的進展期直腸癌病人。從電子病歷擷取TNT開始前的用藥情形（他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈）。主要結果為oCR率，包含臨床完全緩解（cCR）與病理完全緩解（pCR）。次要結果包括整體存活（OS）、癌症特異性存活（CSS）、無病存活（DFS）及無局部復發存活（LRFS）。
結果：360名接受TNT的病人中，95名（26.4%）使用他汀類藥物，30名（8.3%）使用阿斯匹靈。他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈使用者與未使用者之間的oCR率皆無顯著差異（分別為51.9%對40.8%，p＝0.068；43.3%對43.6%，p＝0.974）。同樣地，無論使用他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈，cCR或pCR率皆未觀察到顯著差異。邏輯斯迴歸分析顯示，達成oCR與使用他汀類藥物（OR＝1.55；95% CI，0.97–2.48）或阿斯匹靈（OR＝0.99；95% CI，0.47–2.10）皆無顯著關聯。Cox迴歸分析顯示，他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈的使用與OS、CSS、DFS或LRFS皆無顯著關聯。
結論：他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈的使用，均未與進展期直腸癌接受TNT後腫瘤反應改善呈現獨立關聯。

papers.title: Primary sclerosing cholangitis: epidemiology, risk factors, pathophysiology, clinical features, diagnosis, and management
papers.authors: Song J, Wang B, Yang T, Zhao Z, Liu Y, Ma X
papers.abstract: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a rare cholangiopathy characterized by multifocal inflammation and fibrostenotic remodeling of the bile ducts, cholestasis, and increased risks of cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer. No pharmacological therapy has yet improved transplant-free survival. Clinical care therefore depends on accurate phenotyping, surveillance, treatment of biliary and intestinal complications, and timely liver transplantation. Population-based and clinical studies define the epidemiology, risk factors, presentation, diagnosis, and management of PSC. Studies of human biospecimens, including microbiome and metabolomic analyses, describe biological changes associated with the disease, whereas organoid and animal models are used to investigate potential mechanisms. The available evidence links genetic susceptibility and PSC-associated inflammatory bowel disease to cholangiocyte injury, immune activation, disturbed bile acid homeostasis, and microbial alterations. At the bile duct interface, cholangiocyte senescence and barrier dysfunction may interact with microbial exposure and immune-cell recruitment to promote periductal fibrosis. PSC is therefore more plausibly viewed as a multicellular process than as the consequence of a single microbial, immune, or bile acid pathway. Whether dysbiosis and altered bile acid profiles contribute to disease development or instead reflect established PSC remains unresolved. Concomitant inflammatory bowel disease, medication use, biliary obstruction, and previous biliary interventions further complicate causal inference. Longitudinal human studies may distinguish early drivers from secondary changes. Mechanistic findings should ultimately improve patient phenotyping, surveillance, endoscopic management, and selection for targeted trials. Such trials will require biologically informed designs and endpoints that capture durable clinical benefit.

papers.abstract_zh: 原發性硬化性膽管炎（PSC）是一種罕見膽管疾病，其特徵為膽管多灶性發炎與纖維狹窄性重塑、膽汁鬱積，以及膽管癌與大腸直腸癌風險增加。目前尚無藥物治療能改善免肝臟移植存活。因此，臨床照護仰賴精確的表型分類、監測、膽道與腸道併發症的治療，以及適時進行肝臟移植。以族群為基礎的研究與臨床研究，界定了PSC的流行病學、危險因子、臨床表現、診斷與處置。人類生物檢體研究，包括微生物群與代謝體分析，描述了與疾病相關的生物學變化；類器官與動物模型則用於探究可能的機轉。現有證據將遺傳易感性及PSC相關發炎性腸道疾病，與膽管上皮細胞損傷、免疫活化、膽酸恆定失衡及微生物變化連結起來。在膽管交界處，膽管上皮細胞老化與屏障功能障礙，可能與微生物暴露及免疫細胞募集交互作用，促進膽管周圍纖維化。因此，將PSC視為多細胞參與的過程，比視為單一微生物、免疫或膽酸路徑所造成的結果更為合理。微生物群失衡及膽酸組成改變究竟促成疾病發生，或只是反映已形成的PSC，目前仍未釐清。共存的發炎性腸道疾病、藥物使用、膽道阻塞，以及既往膽道介入處置，進一步增加了因果推論的複雜性。人類縱向研究或可區分早期驅動因素與次發性變化。機轉研究的發現最終應能改善患者表型分類、監測、內視鏡處置，以及標靶治療試驗的收案選擇。此類試驗將需要以生物學知識為基礎的設計，以及能反映持久臨床效益的終點。

papers.title: Deep longitudinal phenotyping of a single individual enables host-microbiome metabolic modeling over 3.6 years
papers.authors: Sheehy A, Martinelli F, Fang X, Smarr L, Palsson B, Knight R
papers.abstract: This study examines a single subject (LS) experiencing severe episodic colonic inflammation and associated gut microbiome dysbiosis. Metagenomic sequencing of LS's stool samples at 51 time points over 3.6 years provided a time series of gut microbial species' relative abundances, from which we generated time-point specific microbiome models. Flux balance analysis was used to predict metabolic phenotypes across the time series. The microbial abundances and predicted fluxes were compared with clinical inflammation biomarkers [serum C-reactive protein (CRP); stool lactoferrin, calprotectin, lysozyme, and secretory immunoglobulin A]. Each of these 51 microbiome models were integrated with a time-point specific male whole-body metabolic model personalized based on LS's weight, blood glucose, and cholesterol. A healthy average (HeAve) community model from 34 individuals provided a reference. Our models predicted methane overproduction from high Methanobrevibacter smithii levels, coinciding with peak CRP and calprotectin. We found that Escherichia coli plays a central role in shaping the predicted metabolome and may promote inflammation through trimethylamine N-oxide and formaldehyde production, out-competing Desulfovibrio piger and Akkermansia muciniphila via active methyl and sulfur cycles. At a later time point, LS experienced a major shift in gut Proteobacteria ecology: E. coli, over-abundant at 675 × HeAve, dropped nearly 80-fold in one month, while Morganella morganii rose by nearly eight times, which coincided with a spike in LS's lactoferrin and lysozyme, a rise in species including Klebsiella pneumoniae and Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, a change in predicted metabolic profile, and increased alpha diversity. We also noted a correlation between postulated inflammation periods and predicted lithocholic acid levels. This work extends two previous studies of 7 and 27 of these time points. Our analysis demonstrates the value of pairing multi-omics time-series data with systems biology approaches in an n-of-1 design, resolving how microbiome composition dynamics shape host-microbiome metabolism and inflammation.
papers.title_zh: 單一個體的深度縱向表型分析，可實現跨越3.6年的宿主—微生物群代謝建模
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討一名出現嚴重陣發性結腸發炎及相關腸道微生物群失衡的受試者（LS）。對LS於3.6年間、51個時間點採集的糞便樣本進行總體基因體定序，取得腸道微生物物種相對豐度的時間序列，並據此建立各時間點特定的微生物群模型。研究使用通量平衡分析，預測整個時間序列中的代謝表型。研究將微生物豐度與預測通量，和臨床發炎生物標記進行比較［血清C反應蛋白（CRP）；糞便乳鐵蛋白、鈣衛蛋白、溶菌酶及分泌型免疫球蛋白A］。這51個微生物群模型，分別與各時間點特定的男性全身代謝模型整合；後者依據LS的體重、血糖及膽固醇進行個人化調整。由34名個體建立的健康平均（HeAve）微生物群落模型作為參照。我們的模型預測，高豐度的史密斯甲烷短桿菌（Methanobrevibacter smithii）會造成甲烷過度生成，且與CRP及鈣衛蛋白達到高峰同時出現。我們發現，大腸桿菌（Escherichia coli）在形塑預測代謝體方面扮演核心角色，且可能透過產生氧化三甲胺及甲醛促進發炎，並藉由活躍的甲基與硫循環，在競爭中勝過Desulfovibrio piger及Akkermansia muciniphila。在較晚的一個時間點，LS的腸道變形菌門生態出現重大轉變：原先過度增多、豐度為HeAve之675倍的大腸桿菌，在一個月內下降近80倍；同時，摩根氏摩根菌（Morganella morganii）增加近8倍。這些變化與LS的乳鐵蛋白及溶菌酶驟升、包括肺炎克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）及普拉梭菌（Faecalibacterium prausnitzii）在內的物種增加、預測代謝輪廓改變，以及α多樣性增加同時發生。我們也注意到，推定的發炎時期與預測的石膽酸濃度之間存在相關性。本研究延伸了先前兩項分別涵蓋上述時間點中7個及27個時間點的研究。我們的分析顯示，在n-of-1設計中，將多體學時間序列資料與系統生物學方法結合具有價值，可釐清微生物群組成的動態變化如何形塑宿主—微生物群代謝與發炎。

papers.title: B cell-macrophage interactions in colorectal cancer: state coupling, spatiotemporal remodeling, and therapeutic implications
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Zhang Y, Lin J, Cheng B
papers.abstract: The immune microenvironment of colorectal cancer (CRC) is characterized by pronounced cellular-state and spatial heterogeneity. B cells and macrophages bridge adaptive and innate immunity, respectively, and engage in bidirectional regulation through antibodies and immune complexes, BAFF/APRIL signaling, cytokines, chemokines, and metabolic cues. These interactions are further shaped by tumor cells, stromal components, microorganisms, and other immune populations within the tumor microenvironment. From the perspective of B cell-macrophage state coupling, this review systematically summarizes the biological foundations and reciprocal communication mechanisms underlying their interactions, with particular emphasis on their dynamic remodeling across different disease stages, tertiary lymphoid structures, distinct spatial niches within tumors, and metastatic progression. We further evaluate how established therapies and emerging experimental interventions influence this cellular network. Current evidence suggests that specific B-cell and macrophage states may form distinct functional combinations within either immune-supportive or immunosuppressive ecosystems. However, direct causal evidence remains limited, and the reproducibility of these associations across independent patient cohorts has yet to be firmly established. Future studies should integrate single-cell sequencing, B-cell receptor clonotype tracking, spatial multi-omics, and functional perturbation approaches to move beyond cellular co-occurrence and computationally inferred communication toward direct validation of functional dependencies. Such efforts will also be essential for determining whether composite state-spatial signatures can improve patient stratification, therapeutic response prediction, and treatment decision-making.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的B細胞與巨噬細胞交互作用：狀態耦合、時空重塑與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）的免疫微環境具有顯著的細胞狀態與空間異質性。B細胞與巨噬細胞分別銜接適應性與先天性免疫，並透過抗體與免疫複合體、BAFF/APRIL訊息傳遞、細胞激素、趨化激素及代謝訊號進行雙向調控。這些交互作用進一步受到腫瘤微環境中的腫瘤細胞、基質成分、微生物及其他免疫細胞族群所形塑。本綜述從B細胞與巨噬細胞狀態耦合的角度，系統性整理其交互作用的生物學基礎與雙向溝通機制，特別著重於不同疾病階段、三級淋巴結構、腫瘤內不同空間生態位，以及轉移進程中的動態重塑。我們進一步評估既有療法與新興實驗性介入如何影響此細胞網絡。目前證據顯示，特定的B細胞與巨噬細胞狀態，可能在支持免疫或抑制免疫的生態系統中形成不同的功能組合。然而，直接因果證據仍然有限，而且這些關聯在獨立病人世代間的可重現性，尚未獲得確立。未來研究應整合單細胞定序、B細胞受體克隆型追蹤、空間多體學及功能性擾動方法，以超越細胞共同出現與電腦推論的細胞溝通，進而直接驗證功能上的相依關係。這些努力也將是判定複合狀態－空間特徵能否改善病人分層、治療反應預測與治療決策的關鍵。
papers.score_reason: 摘要明確承認因果證據與跨世代重現性不足，未提供可量化的臨床效益。適合腫瘤免疫或轉譯研究選題，對台灣大腸直腸外科日常決策的直接價值有限。
papers.relevance_why: 雖聚焦CRC，但內容以免疫機制與研究方向為主，未提供可直接用於外科或全身治療選擇的臨床驗證。

papers.title: Early histological remission and prognosis in inflammatory bowel disease: a nationwide cohort study
papers.authors: Mårild K, Söderling J, Axelrad J, Halfvarson J, Sun J, Forss A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Early remission in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasingly recognized for providing long-term prognostic benefits, despite limited supporting data. We examined the prognostic value of histological remission within 12 months of diagnosis.
METHODS: A nationwide cohort study of 14 019 Swedish IBD patients diagnosed in 1990-2022. These patients underwent ileo-colorectal biopsies showing histological remission or inflammation within 1-<12 months post-diagnosis. We estimated adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for treatment failure (IBD-related surgery, hospitalization, third corticosteroid dispensation, or second-line advanced therapies), colorectal cancer (CRC), and death until 2023. We adjusted for sociodemographic characteristics, comorbidities, IBD phenotype, and medication history.
RESULTS: Early histological remission was more prevalent in patients with higher educational attainment or those diagnosed since 2000, but less common in childhood-onset (<18 years) and elderly-onset (≥60 years) IBD. Average follow-up extended to 13.7 years. Compared to early remission, histological inflammation within 12 months was linked to an increased risk of treatment failure (aHR = 1.47, 95% CI = 1.39-1.54), particularly hospitalization (aHR = 1.46, 95% CI = 1.39-1.54) and second-line advanced therapy (aHR = 1.60, 95% CI = 1.34-1.91). Histological inflammation (vs early remission) was also linked to a heightened CRC risk (aHR = 1.65, 95% CI = 1.21-2.24), with similar risks in Crohn's disease (CD: aHR = 1.66, 95% CI = 0.94-2.93) and ulcerative colitis (UC: aHR = 1.77, 95% CI = 1.20-2.60). Mortality risk was elevated in CD (aHR = 1.21, 95% CI = 1.01-1.45) but not UC (aHR = 0.96, 95% CI = 0.85-1.08). Associations were similar for corticosteroid-free histological remission within 6 and 12 months.
CONCLUSIONS: Sustained histological inflammation (vs remission) 12 months after IBD diagnosis predicted a higher risk of treatment failure and CRC, indicating that early histological remission may improve long-term disease prognosis.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病的早期組織學緩解與預後：全國性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：儘管支持資料有限，發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的早期緩解能帶來長期預後益處，已日益受到重視。我們檢視診斷後12個月內達到組織學緩解的預後價值。
方法：這項全國性世代研究納入14,019名於1990至2022年間確診的瑞典IBD患者。這些患者在診斷後1至未滿12個月內接受迴腸及大腸直腸切片，結果顯示組織學緩解或發炎。我們追蹤至2023年，估計治療失敗（IBD相關手術、住院、第3次皮質類固醇調劑，或使用第二線進階治療）、大腸直腸癌（CRC）與死亡的校正風險比（aHR）。校正變項包括社會人口學特徵、共病、IBD表型與用藥史。
結果：教育程度較高或於2000年起確診的患者，較常出現早期組織學緩解；兒童期發病（<18歲）及老年發病（≥60歲）的IBD患者則較少出現。平均追蹤時間達13.7年。相較於早期緩解，12個月內的組織學發炎與較高的治療失敗風險相關（aHR = 1.47，95% CI = 1.39–1.54），尤其是住院（aHR = 1.46，95% CI = 1.39–1.54）及第二線進階治療（aHR = 1.60，95% CI = 1.34–1.91）。組織學發炎相較於早期緩解，也與較高的CRC風險相關（aHR = 1.65，95% CI = 1.21–2.24）；克隆氏症（CD：aHR = 1.66，95% CI = 0.94–2.93）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC：aHR = 1.77，95% CI = 1.20–2.60）的風險估計相近。CD患者的死亡風險升高（aHR = 1.21，95% CI = 1.01–1.45），但UC患者並未升高（aHR = 0.96，95% CI = 0.85–1.08）。以6個月及12個月內不使用皮質類固醇的組織學緩解進行分析，所見關聯相似。
結論：IBD確診後12個月持續存在組織學發炎，相較於緩解，可預測較高的治療失敗與CRC風險，顯示早期組織學緩解可能改善長期疾病預後。
